property_summary: If fillOrder does not revert, exactly one of the two related positions (orderHash and oppositeOrderHash) has a nonzero positionExpirations and the other is zero.

If fillOrder succeeds (does not revert) when called with an Order that has isLong==true and isCall==true and no ERC20/ERC721 assets and matching floor token lengths, then the maker receives an NFT with id = orderHash (ownerOf(orderHash) == maker) and the taker (msg.sender) receives the opposite position NFT with id = hashOppositeOrder(order).
If fillOrder succeeds for a long call order, the maker becomes owner of token(id=orderHash) and the taker (msg.sender) becomes owner of token(id=hashOppositeOrder(order)).

property_summary: If fillOrder does not revert for a long call order with minimal assets, then the maker owns token id = orderHash and the taker (this contract) owns token id = hashOppositeOrder(order).

Filling an order mints two NFTs (one to maker and one to filler) iff the order signature is valid and order not cancelled and whitelist/duration/expiration/baseAsset checks pass; otherwise fillOrder reverts.

If fillOrder succeeds (does not revert) when called by the filler with valid preconditions, then after the call the maker owns token id = hashOrder(order) and the filler (msg.sender) owns token id = hashOppositeOrder(order).

property_summary: Filling an order mints the maker's long/short NFT and the taker opposite NFT (position IDs are hashes), and if fillOrder succeeds then ownerOf of both position ids equals respective addresses and FilledOrder event implied by state is reflected via owners.

If withdraw(...) succeeds for a short order, the contract transfers either the strike minus fee to the withdrawer or returns the locked assets to them depending on whether the corresponding long was exercised/expired.
